versions.changelog:
creator-content-auditor 19.0.0

- Added distribution-manifest.json for distribution support.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md.
- Expanded and clarified creator feedback instructions; now mandates explicit inclusion of header/status and unknown item listing.
- Minor summary, description, and metadata adjustments; added Chinese summary for “达人内容审核/发布前质检”.
- General contract and usage sections refined for accuracy and audit trail compliance.

- Major update introducing full STAR (Suitability, Trust, Appeal, Return) gatekeeping and veto logic for influencer content audits.
- Calculates the profile-weighted SQS (Star Quality Score) by reading deliverables directly and integrating Suitability from `fit-scorer`.
- Enforces FTC disclosure, factual claim substantiation, brand-safety, and audience authenticity vetoes before approval.
- Provides structured, creator-facing revision feedback mapped to evidence for each required change.
- Formalizes "when to use," compatible roles, and precise user prompt guidance for pre-publish influencer content review.
- Documentation and contract clarify skill scope, evidence requirements, and interaction with other influencer workflow tools.
